title: Gotcha: Resolver refuses already-typed nodes
answers: Why does ResolutionError occur when resolving twice?
body: `Resolver.visit` raises `ResolutionError` if a node already has a type. To re-resolve, first `clone_expr(node, clear_types=True)` as `printer/utils.py:prepare_ast_for_printing` does before the post-Trino-lowering `resolve_types`.
applies: When calling resolve_types on a tree that was already resolved.
says: Why does resolution fail when I try to resolve the same node twice?
How do I re-resolve a node that already has a type?
Can I clear types from a resolved expression to resolve again?
